mapper.insert:
INSERT IGNORE INTO javbus_magnet ( magnet_id, movie_id, code, link, title, is_hd, size_text, size_bytes, share_date, has_subtitle, created_at ) VALUES
( #{item.magnetId}, #{item.movieId}, #{item.code}, #{item.magnet}, #{item.name}, #{item.hd}, #{item.sizeText}, #{item.sizeBytes}, #{item.shareDate}, #{item.subtitle}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT id, magnet_id AS magnetId, movie_id AS movieId, code, link AS magnet, title AS name, is_hd AS hd, size_text AS sizeText, size_bytes AS sizeBytes, share_date AS shareDate, has_subtitle AS subtitle, created_at AS createdAt FROM javbus_magnet WHERE code = #{code} ORDER BY share_date DESC, id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO javbus_magnet_save (code, magnet, saved_date) VALUES (#{code}, #{magnet}, CURDATE())
